payload.claim: The `Projection.kept` docstring promises the value is "the `PullRequest` IRI Q4 would return as `?pr` for it," but the code mints and records a `PullRequest` node for any kept task with a non-null `pr_url` (see the unconditional `if row["pr_url"] is not None:` block later in `materialize`), not only for `MERGED` tasks. Q4 only ever returns `?pr` for a task whose `endedInState` is `factory:MERGED`, so for the common case of a kept task in `READY_FOR_REVIEW`, `APPROVED`, `CHANGES_REQUESTED` or `REJECTED` — all states where PACKAGE has already opened a PR — `kept[task_id]` holds an IRI Q4 will never return. Nothing in this diff's tests exercises a non-merged task with a `pr_url`, and `SA-0108`, which the notes say keys its reconstructability comparison off this IRI, does not exist yet to catch the mismatch; a comparator that trusts the docstring as written risks reading every reviewed-but-unmerged task's PR as a reconstruction failure.
